blurb: Block Brewing Company offers craft beer and BBQ food at two locations in Howell and Brighton, Michigan. Guests can enjoy a variety of beers on tap, stone oven pizzas, and smoked BBQ dishes. Both locations have outdoor patio seating and offer beer to go including howlers, growlers, and canned beer.
